channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: 22-Year-Old Indian Student Missing in California; Consulate Closely Tracking Case
item.description: A postgraduate student at UC Berkeley has been missing since February 10, with local police, Indian authorities and volunteers continuing coordinated search efforts in California.

item.title: People of Purpose: Sanjeeva Kumar Jha’s Story of Grassroots Roots and Corporate Responsibility at JK Lakshmi Cement Ltd
item.description: Sanjeeva Kumar Jha's evolution from Bihar's civil services aspirant to JK Lakshmi Cement's CSR head, transforming 3.5 lakh lives through education, skilling, health, and 50% renewable-powered sustainability.

item.title: School Or Dumping Ground? 30+ Injured As Ghaziabad Farmers Clash With Police Over Land Use
item.description: Farmers demanding a school or hospital instead of a waste plant clashed with police in Ghaziabad, leaving dozens injured.

item.title: Valentine’s Day Tragedy: Noida Couple Found Dead Inside Car; WhatsApp Note Disputed, Caste Murder Alleged
item.description: Police investigate a suspected murder-suicide involving a long-term couple in Noida, while families trade allegations of betrayal and caste-based violence.

item.title: Rare No-Confidence Motion Against Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla Sparks Debate on Parliamentary Neutrality
item.description: The Opposition accuses the Lok Sabha Speaker of partisan conduct during the Budget Session, while the government defends procedure ahead of a rare March 9 debate.

item.title: UP Tragedy: CCTV Captures 65-Foot High Mast Pole Killing 48-Year-Old Samajwadi Party Leader’s Car in Pratapgarh
item.description: A high mast light pole being installed near a petrol pump collapsed onto a moving car in Pratapgarh, triggering outrage and an investigation into alleged safety lapses.

item.title: 12 Deaths in 15 Days: Haryana Village Faces Probe Over Water Contamination, Hepatitis B Fears
item.description: A mysterious illness linked to suspected water contamination has led to multiple deaths and mass screenings in a Haryana village.

item.title: Maharashtra: Thane Balkum Fire Contained in 2 Hours; Swift Action Prevents Casualties in Dense Neighbourhood
item.description: A temporary warehouse storing mobile and fibre cables in Thane’s Balkum area caught fire late at night, prompting a rapid two-hour firefighting operation that prevented casualties and further damage.

item.title: 5 Die in Bengaluru After Car Jumps Divider, Crashes Into KSRTC Bus on Tumakuru Road
item.description: Five youths from Doddaballapur died after their car hit a divider, crossed lanes and collided with a KSRTC bus carrying 43 passengers on Tumakuru Road near Bengaluru.

item.title: PM Modi Highlights ₹7.85 Lakh Crore Defence Allocation In Budget 2026, Calls Military Reform Key To India’s Developed Vision
item.description: With a 15% rise in defence allocation, the government says modernisation and indigenisation are central to India’s security and 2047 development vision.
